description: This file is a C header file defining the exported APIs for the Beep Env Request Object in the BSP execution environment. It contains function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing the Beep Env Request Object.

methods.name: BeepCreateEnvRequest
methods.description: Creates a new Beep Environment Request Object with specified container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: BeepEnvReqoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Beep Environment Request Object.

methods.name: BeepEnvReqoRemove
methods.description: Removes or deallocates the specified Beep Environment Request Object.

methods.name: BeepEnvReqoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary sub-objects within the Beep Environment Request Object.

methods.name: BeepEnvReqoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Beep Environment Request Object.
